The First Signs of Alien Civilization May Be Seen By Australian Telescope.
So it's just like the SETI program but with bigger telescopes? Of course bigger is better but what if the Aliens don't transmit data in the way we know? What if they use a different medium?

Searching for ETI is a tough thing. You have to make a lot of assumptions, any number of which could render your search invalid. That being said, the assumptions we've made are, we believe the best ones. It's sort of a shot in the dark.

It's not the content of the signal we're interested in right now. It's whether or not there's a signal at all.

To that end, we're listening to the clearest frequency we can. Nothing travels faster than light, that we know of, so communication will probably take place using light. Radio light, specifically, is really good at penetrating all the stuff that's in the universe - dust and gas, mostly. Super-specifically, the frequency of 1420 Mhz, aka the Hydrogen Line.

There's lots of science you can read there, but simply put that frequency is the quietest and has the best penetrative power. It's the perfect place to broadcast if you wanted to talk to anyone. Indeed, we've already picked up on something that has all the right markers for a SETI signal.

But you're totally right - if they're not broadcasting on that frequency, or even in radio light (or light, period) then we'd never pick up on the signal. That's why this prize is so important - by investing in the search, we can develop and adapt more technology, listen to more and more stuff.
